objectives.title: Special Category Data Processing Restrictions
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding prohibitions on processing special categories of personal data.
criteria: Clauses identifying restrictions on processing data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, or trade union membership.
Clauses identifying restrictions on processing genetic data.
Clauses identifying restrictions on processing biometric data used for unique identification.
Clauses identifying restrictions on processing health data.
Clauses identifying restrictions on processing data concerning sex life or sexual orientation.

objectives.title: Explicit Consent Verification for Sensitive Data
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding explicit consent mechanisms for sensitive data processing.
criteria: Provisions verifying customer acquisition of explicit data subject consent.
Mechanisms recording specific purposes for processing sensitive data.
Clauses acknowledging that applicable Union or Member State law may bar explicit consent from lifting the special category processing prohibition.

objectives.title: Professional Secrecy Safeguards
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding professional secrecy duties applicable to personnel handling sensitive health information.
criteria: Contractual secrecy commitments binding cloud provider personnel.
Duty of confidentiality declarations for medical data handlers.

objectives.title: Jurisdictional Sensitive Data Limitations
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding national law limitations on sensitive data.
criteria: Provisions addressing national statutory restrictions on genetic data.
Provisions addressing national statutory restrictions on biometric data.
Provisions addressing national statutory restrictions on health data.

objectives.title: Special Category Lawful Basis Identification
objectives.description: The contract contains writings identifying legal bases, other than explicit consent, that permit processing special categories of personal data.
criteria: Provisions identifying employment, social security, or social protection law as the basis for processing special category data.
Provisions identifying preventive or occupational medicine, medical diagnosis, or health or social care purposes as the basis for processing special category data.
Provisions identifying substantial public interest or public health grounds as the basis for processing special category data.
Provisions identifying archiving, scientific, historical research, or statistical purposes as the basis for processing special category data.
